articles.title: LaLiga sufre un ciberataque con acceso a datos personales de aficionados
articles.standfirst: La patronal, que detectó una intrusión en una plataforma de servicios digitales entre los días 14 y 16 de noviembre, ha denunciado los hechos ante la Policía Nacional
articles.summary: La patronal, que detectó una intrusión en una plataforma de servicios digitales entre los días 14 y 16 de noviembre, ha denunciado los hechos ante la Policía Nacional
articles.body: LaLiga ha informado de que ha sido víctima de un ciberataque que permitió el acceso no autorizado a datos personales de usuarios registrados en servicios digitales de la patronal y de algunos clubes. Según ha explicado la propia organización, el incidente se produjo entre los días 14 y 16 de noviembre, cuando un ciberdelincuente logró acceder de forma ilegítima a una de las plataformas tecnológicas destinadas a servicios para aficionados y extraer información personal de usuarios registrados. Los equipos de seguridad de LaLiga detectaron el origen del acceso y, el pasado 16 de noviembre, activaron las medidas necesarias para contener el ataque, detener la extracción de datos y bloquear al responsable. Desde la entidad aseguran que el incidente ha quedado limitado a esa plataforma concreta y que no ha afectado al resto de sistemas tecnológicos ni al desarrollo de las competiciones. La organización mantiene abierta una investigación interna para determinar el alcance exacto de la brecha de seguridad y conocer cuántos usuarios podrían haberse visto afectados. Paralelamente, ha reforzado los mecanismos de supervisión y vigilancia de sus sistemas con el objetivo de detectar posibles nuevos intentos de intrusión. Además, LaLiga ha comunicado el incidente a la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (AEPD) y ha presentado una denuncia ante la Unidad Central de Ciberdelincuencia de la Policía Nacional, que ya investiga lo sucedido. También ha trasladado la información a los clubes afectados, con los que está coordinando las actuaciones derivadas de este incidente.

articles.title: Crisis total en el Huesca: "Hacía tiempo que no pasaba tanta vergüenza"
articles.standfirst: Los oscenses temen encadenar dos descensos consecutivos tras hacer el ridículo ante el Ibiza
articles.summary: Los oscenses temen encadenar dos descensos consecutivos tras hacer el ridículo ante el Ibiza
articles.body: El Huesca atraviesa un momento muy delicado. Tras bajar a Primera RFEF hace unos meses, la afición confiaba en recuperar la ilusión con una buena temporada en la que poder volver a Segunda. Nada más lejos de la realidad. El equipo está en una crisis total y amenaza el puesto de Albert Rudé, segundo técnico del curso. Su efecto se ha terminado y encadenan tres derrotas consecutivas, sin marcar además, que ha dejado a los azulgranas a solo dos puntos del descenso. El 0-4 frente al Ibiza ha dinamitado todo. El entrenador catalán fue muy tajante en rueda de prensa y no piensa en su destitución: "Dando esta imagen, ¿quién crees que saldrá primero? El entrenador es lo más fácil. Voy a dar todo con un compromiso brutal. Lo primero es pedir disculpas a la afición, tanto a la gente del estadio, como la de casa. No se puede dejar esta imagen. Estoy ocupadísimo en revertir esto. Hasta que me dejen, sea mucho o poco, voy a dar todo, voy a ser un fiel creyente y me voy a revelar por revertir esto a este vestuario y a la gente que esté en la misma sintonía, que quiera participar y trabajar. Quien no, puede levantar la mano y salirse de la ecuación". Al término de la goleada sufrida, Rudé y los jugadores se acercaron a la afición para dar explicaciones: "Está en peligro perder el apoyo de la gente. No podemos pedirles confianza sin ofrecerles algo a cambio. La responsabilidad es exclusivamente nuestra. Me han preguntado qué estaba pasando y cómo puede ser que demos esta imagen. La gente sigue creyendo, pero necesita que nosotros reaccionemos. Quiero que dentro de unos meses podamos recordar esta situación y sentirnos orgullosos de haberla superado, de haberle dado la vuelta". Uno de los capitanes como Sergi Enrich también fue muy duro con sus declaraciones: “Hacía mucho tiempo que no pasaba tanta vergüenza. Nadie quería el balón. Nos escondíamos, y si quieres ser jugador profesional no puedes hacer esto. Te pueden meter uno o dos, pero nunca cuatro de la manera que se ha visto. La derrota ha sido muy dolorosa. Estamos muy jodidos, y si hay alguien que no lo esté que se vaya. La responsabilidad que tenemos todos es muy alta porque sabemos dónde estamos. Ha sido un palo muy duro, y evidentemente el vestuario está como tiene que estar, jodido. Hay que sobreponerse porque sigo creyendo que hay una buena plantilla”. El delantero pide actitud y valentía para salir de abajo: “Para darle la vuelta hay que tener cojones y responsabilidad. Estamos en un club en el que hay cosas que no se pueden permitir y una es lo que hemos hecho. Si nos tenemos que ir todos en el mercado de invierno por el bien del club y del equipo, nos vamos. Aquí estamos para aportar, el primero yo. Hay que competir y hacer lo que nos pide el míster. Si el míster nos pide que nos choquemos contra la pared, lo hacemos y punto. Estamos a tiempo, y espero y deseo que no pase lo que sucedió el año pasado porque fue un año pasado durísimo”.

articles.title: El CSD aprueba la venta accionarial del 42% del Valencia al fondo de inversión americano Pitchwise
articles.standfirst: A falta del ok definitivo de 'Inversión extranjera' la operación de venta de las acciones de Peter Lim está cerrada
articles.summary: A falta del ok definitivo de 'Inversión extranjera' la operación de venta de las acciones de Peter Lim está cerrada
articles.body: El Consejo Superior de Deportes ha comunicado durante la mañana de hoy al Valencia, tenía de plazo hasta el seis de febrero, que la operación accionarial de venta del 42% de las acciones de Meriton Holdings (Peter Lim) al fondo de inversión americano Pitchwise está aprobada. Esto significa que tras estudiar el desembolso de 430 millones de dólares no se han encontrado inconvenientes legales en esta operación. Tras el sí del CSD faltan algunos escalones burocráticos para que se pueda dar oficialidad al desembarco americano. Uno de ellos depende de Inversión Extranjera, un organismo dependiente del gobierno de España y que también debe firmar la documentación. La noticia da tranquilidad al club ya que pone en marcha de forma oficial el nuevo equilibrio de poderes dentro de la entidad blanquinegra. De momento, al llegar el ok oficial antes de que se cierre el mercado invernal, los 100 millones anunciados en el acuerdo de venta para reforzar la plantilla estarán presentes en breve y Braulio podrá trabajar con garantías el mercado. Además, la oficialidad trae algunas consecuencias directas. Tanto Ann Rodríguez como Corey Woolfolk estará presentes en la Junta General de accionistas que se celebrará en Valencia a principios de diciembre y en la que también estará el presidente del club y representante del máximo accionista de la entidad Kiat Lim.

articles.title: Las peñas del Real Oviedo señalan a Pachuca y a la plantilla
articles.standfirst: APARO eleva el tono ante el mal momento del equipo carbayón y reclama que se asuman responsabilidades
articles.summary: APARO eleva el tono ante el mal momento del equipo carbayón y reclama que se asuman responsabilidades
articles.body: Las peñas del Real Oviedo han alzado la voz tras la visita y la derrota del equipo en Córdoba. La Asociación de Peñas Azules del Real Oviedo (APARO) apuntó este lunes tanto al Grupo Pachuca, propietario del club, como a la plantilla. De ambos dice que “no están entendiendo lo que es el Real Oviedo”. El mensaje, publicado en las redes sociales de los aficionados, llega en las primeras semanas de Raúl González al frente del equipo, después de que el técnico tomara el relevo de Julián Calero. La asociación también cuestiona las decisiones de la directiva y asegura que su gestión “genera cada vez más desconfianza” entre los aficionados. “La paciencia del oviedismo tiene un límite”, avisó APARO, que reprocha a los dirigentes la falta de respuestas ante el mal momento del club. La agrupación cerró su mensaje con una exigencia: “Se deben asumir responsabilidades”. Por otro lado, el club ha pedido a sus socios y abonados que extremen la precaución ante posibles intentos de suplantación. El aviso llega después de que alguien accediera a una plataforma de LaLiga y se llevara datos personales de usuarios de sus servicios digitales y de varios clubes, entre ellos el asturiano. El Oviedo aconseja desconfiar de los correos, mensajes o llamadas que parezcan proceder del club y soliciten contraseñas, información personal o un pago. En esos casos, pide evitar los enlaces que acompañen al mensaje y confirmar la petición por los canales oficiales. La entidad facilita el correo abonados@realoviedo.es para resolver dudas. La plataforma atacada está gestionada por LaLiga y, según el Oviedo, la intrusión dejó intactos los sistemas y las bases de datos del club. La entidad asturiana trabaja con la patronal para identificar qué información se ha visto comprometida y a cuántos usuarios afecta. “Informaremos directamente a las personas afectadas en cuanto dispongamos de esa información”, anunció el club.

articles.title: Oyono vuelve al plan de Terzic en una sesión sin Berenguer, Yuri y Yeray
articles.standfirst: El delantero cuenta con opciones de entrar en la próxima lista de Copa por la baja de Imga
articles.summary: El delantero cuenta con opciones de entrar en la próxima lista de Copa por la baja de Imga
articles.body: El Athletic entrena esta tarde en las instalaciones de Lezama en una sesión abierta al público. Alrededor de 1.500 aficionados se han dado cita en las gradas del campo de juego que habitualmente utiliza el Bilbao Athletic para seguir la primera jornada de trabajo de esta semana para el equipo de Terzic. Oyono, delantero del filial de 18 años de edad, es una de las caras nuevas en una práctica en la que no toman parte Berenguer, Yuri y Yeray. Los tres jugaron todo el partido del pasado viernes ante el Espanyol. Yeray terminó el encuentro con problemas físicos antes de la última tanda de cambios, pero aguanto en el césped hasta la conclusión. El delantero, nacido en Barakaldo, llegó al Athletic en 2024 procedente del Villarreal, club que en 2021 le había reclutado de la escuela formativa del Barakaldo. Oyono tiene muchas opciones de estar en la lista de convocados para el partido de Copa de la próxima semana ante el Numancia, más todavía porque Imga ha vuelto lesionado del Mundial sub17 y Conde, que ya ha debutado como león en Copa, terminó el encuentro de Liga del Bilbao Athletic ante el Mirandés con molestias.

articles.title: Luís Castro: “Me han preguntado cinco veces por el árbitro y no puedo hablar”
articles.standfirst: El entrenador portugués no ha podido expresar su opinión respecto a la actuación del trencilla
articles.summary: El entrenador portugués no ha podido expresar su opinión respecto a la actuación del trencilla
articles.body: El partido tuvo un protagonista más allá de lo normal. El árbitro. El técnico portugués fue cuestionado, hasta en cinco ocasiones por la actuación del trencilla en el choque ante el Elche y no pudo mostrar su opinión. Así mismo, el entrenador luso afirmó que, tanto Manu Sánchez como Toljan, quedan a la espera de diferentes pruebas médicas para conocer el estado físico de ambos jugadores. “Me han preguntado en la flash y no puedo hablar. Si me vuelven a preguntar, yo no hablo". “No puedo responder a esto porque después de mi opinión van a un lado que yo no quiero”. “Haremos análisis mañana pero es una acción que tú estas por delante del adversario y cuando te hacen la acción, te desequilibra y hacen daño en la rodilla. Esperemos que no sea nada grave. Es una acción muy difícil porque vas a mucha velocidad y no miras si hay un contacto”. “Estaba haciendo un buen partido, probablemente el mejor. Ha tenido una dolencia muscular y esperamos que no sea nada grave. Mañana lo analizaremos. Ha tenido un pequeño dolor muscular. Pienso que no estará para el Racing”. “Me han hecho cuatro preguntas del árbitro y no puedo hablar”. “Es un empate. La justicia en el futbol no es fácil. Yo dije en Vigo que los vencedores eran ellos y hoy, si hubiera ganado alguien, hubiéramos sido nosotros. Hemos hecho 18 remates y no hemos más daño porque no hemos podido. Empezamos muy bien y en la segunda mitad, perdimos el control. Con menos control más corazón, tuvimos más ocasiones. De la misma forma que en Vigo dije que el punto era bueno, hoy tengo que decir que el punto es malo porque merecíamos ganar”. “Ha sido un problema para nosotros porque queríamos hacer cambios. Cuando sufrimos el gol, yo ya estaba pensando que necesitábamos un cambio, pero si lo hubiéramos hecho, nos hubiéramos quedado sin poder hacer más cambios. Nos han condicionado las decisiones”. “Vosotros me conoces bien y siempre digo lo que pienso. No hago películas. Desde el principio él tenía que estar en la primera plantilla porque él lo ha ganado. Lo que hace, cada que vez que lo metes en el campo, te demuestra que está. Esa acción es muy buena, pero no solo esa. Ha estado a buen nivel. Nunca he entrado a un jugador con su edad y con su nivel. Su evolución no lo sé. Si es normal su evolución”.

articles.title: Manipur to get first taste of ISL as NorthEast United face SC Delhi
articles.summary: KOLKATA: For decades, it has played the supply line for the Indian national team.
articles.body: KOLKATA: For decades, it has played the supply line for the Indian national team. Yet, on multiple occasions, especially during the ongoing conflict, it has had to see its clubs play their home games away from home.However, on Tuesday, it will come full circle for the Manipur football fans as the current top-tier Indian Super League will make its debut in Imphal as NorthEast United FC will travel to their northeast neighbours for their fixture against SC Delhi at Khuman Lumpak Main Stadium.For NEUFC players like Soraisham Dinesh Singh, Tondonba Ngasepam, Danny Laishram Meitei, Saikhom Thoiba Singh and Buanthanglun Samte, it will be a cherished chance to play in the club colours in their home state, in front of their friends and family.“I’m so happy to be home. This is my hometown. Let’s see what tomorrow (Tuesday) brings. I hope we win,” Dinesh said at the pre-match press conference in Imphal on Monday.But at the back of the mind of all the Highlanders players on the field will be an eagerness to get back to winning ways after falling to FC Goa in their last match in Guwahati, a result that ended their unbeaten run in the season.However, sitting on third spot and facing a team lying just a rung below in the table and unbeaten in their last four games, head coach Juan Pedro Benali is aware of not letting the setback on Saturday affect the players in a negative way.“The Goa game is in the past. We can’t change the result, but we can change some of the things we do on the pitch,” the Spanish coach said on Monday.NEUFC conceded with the earliest goal of the season, courtesy a defensive error from Pramveer Singh and Muhammed Nemil taking advantage with a breakthrough in the 35th second.And while they dominated most of the remaining minutes, with Alaaeddine Ajaraie, Ethyan Gonzalez and Macarton Nickson coming close to an equaliser, Benali’s men failed to recover with a goal.Ajaraie and his co-attackers will be keen to change the script in Imphal. But they would be aware of the threat from Delhi’s Carlos Fortes and Juan Pena, who have both scored three goals apiece so far.With a lot at stake for both ISL teams, the Manipur fans will hopefully be in for a treat on the field in their first encounter with top-tier Indian club football.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Un ex del Barcelona se enfrenta a sus malos recuerdos del Madrid: "Para todo hay una primera vez"
articles.standfirst: Sergiño Dest, ex del Barcelona, juega contra el Real Madrid en Champions con la camiseta del PSV Eindhoven
articles.summary: Sergiño Dest, ex del Barcelona, juega contra el Real Madrid en Champions con la camiseta del PSV Eindhoven
articles.body: Sergiño Dest, jugador del F.C. Barcelona 2020 a 2024, se reencuentra con el Real Madrid en Champions League vistiendo la camiseta del PSV Eindhoven. El lateral internacional con Estados Unidos ha confesado que no tiene muy buenos recuerdos del Real Madrid. "Mis recuerdos no son muy positivos en cuanto a partidos contra Real Madrid. En el Bernabéu no he jugado, hubo obras. Los partidos contra Real Madrid son difíciles, ya tengo experiencia en eso. Cuando juegas contra ellos tienes que darlo todo", reconoció el defensa nacido en Países Bajos. En declaraciones que reproduce 'Fox Deportes' el futbolista del PSV Eindhoven también habla de su relación actual con el Barça: "No tengo tanta comunicación con mis compañeros del Barcelona, a veces con Frenkie de Jong. He jugado en el Barcelona y siempre quieres ganar al Real Madrid". Sergiño Dest confía en conseguir su primera victoria ante el Real Madrid, aunque reconoce que "va a ser muy difícil ganar al Real Madrid, para todo hay una primera vez, y mañana sería la primera vez para nosotros, pero va a ser difícil". "El Real Madrid es un club excelente, pero vamos a ver. No sabemos de antemano lo que va a pasar, jugamos bien contra Liverpool y Nápoles y tampoco fueron partidos fáciles. Vamos a ver lo que pasa, es un partido abierto. Tenemos que centrarnos en nuestros objetivos y complicar el juego al Real Madrid", analizó sobre las opciones del PSV Eindhoven de ganar al Real Madrid en el Santiago Bernabéu.

articles.title: Quebradero de cabeza para Anselmi: Lemar cae lesionado en su reaparición
articles.standfirst: El mediocentro del Elche sufrió un “pinchazo en el isquio” frente al Levante, duelo en el que fue sustituido tras entrar en el segundo acto
articles.summary: El mediocentro del Elche sufrió un “pinchazo en el isquio” frente al Levante, duelo en el que fue sustituido tras entrar en el segundo acto
articles.body: Las lesiones siguen persiguiendo a Thomas Lemar. El mediocentro del Elche vuelve al dique seco, con la mala fortuna de hacerlo el día de su reaparición. Lemar tuvo que ser sustituido en los últimos compases del partido frente al Levante (1-1), en el que ingresó como revulsivo tras el descanso. Según explicó Martín Anselmi, técnico franjiverde, el francés “pidió el cambió” por “un pinchazo en el isquio”. Una lesión distinta a la que sufrió tres semanas antes frente al Valencia (0-1), pero que también le va a dejar fuera de los terrenos de juego. “Veremos el grado de lesión cuando se haga una resonancia”, añadió Anselmi, quien reconoció la importancia capital de Lemar en el juego ilicitano. “Genera dependencia en cualquier equipo. Nos hace jugar con su jerarquía”, expuso Anselmi. Y así se vio en el Ciutat de València, ya que con la entrada del francés al campo, el rendimiento ofensivo del Elche mejoró sustancialmente. A falta de confirmar el grado de la lesión, Lemar apunta a perderse el próximo duelo frente al Atlético de Madrid (sábado, 18:30 horas, Martínez Valero). Cabe recordar que el ex del Mónaco milita en el Elche cedido por el Atlético de Madrid. Anselmi cruza los dedos para que, en el caso más optimista, el ‘18’ franjiverde pueda reaparecer en la posterior visita a Osasuna. Rubén Sánchez, también KO La baja de Lemar no es la única que ha sufrido el equipo ilicitano recientemente. Anselmi también informó de que Rubén Sánchez se perdió la visita a Orriols por “un desgarro en el aductor”, producido en la sesión de entrenamiento del pasado viernes. El lateral derecho, titular en la jornada anterior frente al Betis (0-2), estará varias semanas KO.

articles.title: Los secretos de Carlos Espí que explican su éxito en el Real Madrid: "No tenía miedo a nada"
articles.standfirst: Javi Tur y Pascu Domingo, entrenadores del jugador de niño, repasan en La Tribu los inicios del delantero, su irrupción en el conjunto blanco y su posible compatibilidad con Mbappé
articles.summary: Javi Tur y Pascu Domingo, entrenadores del jugador de niño, repasan en La Tribu los inicios del delantero, su irrupción en el conjunto blanco y su posible compatibilidad con Mbappé
articles.body: La irrupción de Carlos Espí en el Real Madrid está siendo uno de los grandes aciertos de José Mourinho en este inicio de temporada. El delantero ha marcado cuatro goles decisivos en apenas 81 minutos de juego. Javi Tur y Pascu Domingo, dos de los primeros entrenadores del futbolista, han pasado por La Tribu de Radio MARCA con Pablo Villa para descubrir los orígenes del atacante y analizar su momento en el conjunto blanco. Tur, que dirigió a Espí durante dos temporadas en categoría prebenjamín en el Tavernes, recordó la valentía que mostraba el delantero desde pequeño: "Siempre con el balón, desde que nació prácticamente. Ha sido una persona muy joven, muy valiente, con mucha fuerza y no tenía miedo a nada". Su primer entrenador también reconoció la sorpresa que supuso su fichaje por el Real Madrid y destacó la importancia de su entorno familiar: "Nadie sabía nada, la familia lo llevó muy en secreto y fue una alegría porque es el mejor sitio donde puede estar". Además, puso en valor su capacidad para aprovechar las oportunidades: "En cualquier equipo que ha estado, siempre ha superado las expectativas que se esperaban de él". El día que Carlos Espí salvó a su entrenador Por su parte, Pascu Domingo, actualmente entrenador del juvenil de División de Honor del Real Murcia, recordó una anécdota de su etapa en el Alzira. El técnico decidió ascender a Espí del juvenil C al juvenil B en un momento especialmente delicado para su continuidad en el banquillo. "Yo sabía que si no ganábamos se me acababa mi etapa en Alzira y decidimos subirnos a Carlos. Mete varios goles, nos salva tanto al equipo como al cuerpo técnico y todos los equipos se fijan en él. Ese día, como bien dice Juanjo, el padre de Carlos, empezó todo", recordó. Domingo también destacó la mentalidad del delantero para gestionar la falta de minutos y lanzó un aviso al madridismo: "La afición del Real Madrid aún no conoce al 200% a Carlos". ¿Compatible con Mbappé? El entrenador no tiene ninguna duda sobre la posibilidad de que Espí y Mbappé compartan ataque en el Real Madrid. "Ojalá pueda ver a Mbappé y Carlos en un once titular. Bajo mi punto de vista, claro que es compatible", aseguró. Domingo confía en que el técnico portugués termine premiando el rendimiento del delantero con una titularidad junto al francés: "Cuando se le ha dado oportunidades a Carlos las ha aprovechado. Tiene que llegar esa oportunidad y estoy seguro de que Mourinho se la va a dar".

articles.title: Irene Junquera defiende a los árbitros: "No creo que hagan algo a propósito"
articles.standfirst: La periodista analiza en La Tribu la presión que soportan los colegiados en los grandes partidos y rechaza que sus errores sean deliberados
articles.summary: La periodista analiza en La Tribu la presión que soportan los colegiados en los grandes partidos y rechaza que sus errores sean deliberados
articles.body: Irene Junquera, Ricardo Reyes, Emilio Pérez de Rozas, José Manuel Oliván, Amalio Moratalla y Alberto Santacruz han sido los tertulianos de este martes en La Tribu, patrocinada por Sportium durante esta temporada, para analizar la actualidad deportiva marcada por la polémica entorno a los árbitros y la nueva jornada de Champions. Irene Junquera, Ricardo Reyes, Emilio Pérez de Rozas, José Manuel Oliván, Amalio Moratalla y Alberto Santacruz han sido los tertulianos de este martes en La Tribu, patrocinada por Sportium durante esta temporada, para analizar la actualidad deportiva marcada por la polémica en torno a los árbitros y la nueva jornada de Champions. Irene Junquera quiso romper una lanza a favor de los colegiados y puso el foco en la presión a la que están sometidos, especialmente en los encuentros de mayor repercusión. "Son humanos. A veces dirán: 'Como me equivoque en un partido grande, la que me va a caer..'. Entonces tienen más presión, pero no creo que ellos hagan algo a propósito, de verdad, lo he pensado siempre", explicó. La presión sobre los colegiados La periodista considera que el problema está en atribuir intencionalidad a los errores arbitrales, aunque reconoce que el escenario en el que se disputa un encuentro puede condicionar a los colegiados: "Donde veo el error es pensar que lo hacen deliberadamente. Yo creo que son humanos y que, efectivamente, las presiones en según qué estadio les pasarán más o menos factura, pero no creo que lo hagan a propósito". Por su parte, Javi Amaro introdujo otro argumento en el debate, haciendo referencia al desarrollo de los encuentros y al dominio de los grandes equipos: "¿Cómo se van a equivocar a favor del Villarreal en Barcelona si en la segunda parte no pasó del centro del campo?".

articles.title: El Burgos se cita con un histórico de la Copa que vuelve a sonreír
articles.standfirst: El Real Zaragoza, campeón del torneo en seis ocasiones, lidera el Grupo II de Primera RFEF
articles.summary: El Real Zaragoza, campeón del torneo en seis ocasiones, lidera el Grupo II de Primera RFEF
articles.body: La Copa del Rey ha querido volver a cruzar los caminos del Burgos y el Real Zaragoza. Apenas un año después de que Mario González silenciara el Ibercaja Estadio con un gol en la prórroga, los blanquinegros regresarán a tierras aragonesas el próximo jueves 3 de diciembre (21.00 horas) con el objetivo de repetir la historia. Sin embargo, poco tiene que ver el Zaragoza de entonces con el que se encontrarán ahora los de Sergio Francisco. El descenso a Primera Federación supuso uno de los golpes más duros en la historia reciente del conjunto maño, que ha encontrado en Ibai Gómez al encargado de devolver la ilusión al zaragocismo. El técnico vasco ha conseguido reconstruir un equipo que domina con autoridad el Grupo II de la tercera categoría del fútbol español, con 6 puntos de ventaja sobre su inmediato perseguidor y 12 jornadas consecutivas sin conocer la derrota. La diferencia de categoría puede resultar engañosa. Mientras el Burgos pelea por consolidarse en los puestos de playoffs de ascenso a Primera, el Zaragoza ha convertido su regreso al fútbol profesional en su gran objetivo y los números avalan la transformación del conjunto aragonés: 9 victorias, 3 empates y 1 derrota: desde su tropiezo en el estreno liguero, no ha vuelto a perder. Ibai Gómez cuenta con una plantilla que combina experiencia en el fútbol profesional y juventud. Ander Herrera ejerce como uno de los referentes del vestuario, mientras que futbolistas como Marco Sangalli, Edu Espiau o Rubén Díez aportan experiencia a un equipo con numerosos recursos ofensivos. Hablar del Zaragoza es hacerlo de uno de los históricos del torneo del KO. Los aragoneses conquistaron el título en 1964, 1966, 1986, 1994, 2001 y 2004, esta última frente al Real Madrid. Un palmarés al que se añaden la Recopa de Europa de 1995 y la Copa de Ferias de 1964. El Burgos, además, tiene cuentas pendientes con la historia copera del conjunto maño. En diciembre de 2021 cayó eliminado en La Romareda (2-0), antes de tomarse la revancha la pasada temporada con aquel tanto de Mario González en el minuto 115. Esta vez, el Zaragoza llega tras golear al Tudelano (0-4), mientras que los burgaleses tuvieron que remontar ante el Laredo (2-4) para superar su estreno en la competición. El premio para los de Sergio Francisco será la posibilidad de regresar a El Plantío en dieciseisavos, ronda en la que entrarán en escena los participantes de la Supercopa de España. Pero antes deberán superar a un histórico que ha recuperado la sonrisa.

articles.title: Marruecos señala una presunta llamada entre un árbitro del TAS y el presidente de Senegal antes del fallo
articles.standfirst: Senegal lo desmiente y califica la supuesta conversación de imaginaria
articles.summary: Senegal lo desmiente y califica la supuesta conversación de imaginaria
articles.body: La espera del fallo sobre la Copa de África tiene un nuevo frente de controversia. Marruecos ha comunicado al Tribunal de Arbitraje Deportivo una presunta llamada entre Abdoulaye Fall, presidente de la Federación Senegalesa de Fútbol, y uno de los árbitros del procedimiento, según una fuente conocedora del expediente citada por Reuters. La parte senegalesa ha rechazado la acusación. La llamada se habría producido el pasado domingo en la que se identifica a Ulrich Haas, el jurista alemán que forma parte del panel encargado de resolver el recurso presentado por Senegal. Se trata de una alegación de la parte marroquí, no de un hecho acreditado públicamente. Reuters no ha podido confirmar de forma independiente que la conversación tuviera lugar ni determinar su contenido. El TAS tampoco estaba disponible para responder a la agencia cuando se publicó la información. Desde Senegal, la respuesta ha llegado a través de Abdoulaye Sow, secretario general de la federación. Según el medio local Senego, el dirigente negó la conversación en declaraciones al periodista Malang Sané y calificó la supuesta llamada de "imaginaria". También sostuvo que Fall "ni siquiera conoce a los jueces" implicados en el procedimiento y que no estuvo presente en la audiencia. El episodio llega en plena cuenta atrás para la resolución. El tribunal anunció el lunes que comunicará su decisión este martes 24 de noviembre por la tarde, sin concretar una hora. También recordó que únicamente sus canales oficiales deben considerarse válidos para conocer cualquier anuncio sobre el caso. La disputa enfrenta el resultado del campo con la posterior decisión de la Confederación Africana de Fútbol. Senegal ganó la final de enero por 1-0 en la prórroga, pero la CAF anuló ese desenlace y concedió a Marruecos una victoria por 3-0 al considerar que la retirada temporal de los senegaleses suponía un abandono. Senegal recurrió para recuperar el título.

articles.title: Man City 2-2 Napoli: Rayan Cherki equalises late but Enzo Maresca's team frustrate in Champions League draw
articles.summary: Match report as Manchester City drew 2-2 with Napoli in the Champions League at the Etihad Stadium. Rasmus Hojlund and Noa Lang twice put the Italian side in front but equalisers from Ayyoub Bouaddi and Rayan Cherki earned Enzo Maresca's men a point
articles.body:
Former Manchester United striker Rasmus Hojlund opened the scoring for the Italian side and though Ayyoub Bouaddi equalised, Noa Lang's volley stunned the Etihad Stadium as Napoli restored their lead late on. Cherki's goal at least secured a point.

The draw leaves City in sixth spot in the Champions League table but they are likely to drop out of the top eight by Wednesday evening and have now gone 10 games without a clean sheet. Maresca's men look vulnerable ahead of the trip to Arsenal on Sunday.

With little to cheer in the first half, the home crowd took most pleasure in serenading Kevin De Bruyne on his return - King Kev declared one banner - and he gave glimpses of his quality, twice cutting City's defence apart. But the sluggish tempo suited a veteran.

It was all a little too slow from City. Maresca was trying to tighten up in midfield, picking Bouaddi as well as Elliot Anderson and Enzo Fernandez for only the second time. But it left this City side short of thrust in the last third despite Allan's impressive endeavour.

It needed a strong save from Gianluigi Donnarumma to ensure City went in level at the break. Sam Beukema made firm contact with a free header inside the box but the Napoli defender placed it too close to the goalkeeper. The home side did not heed the warning.

Billy Gilmour fed Hojlund inside the box on the angle and he got the shot away under pressure from Marc Guehi to beat Donnarumma low to his left. It was a sweet moment for the Danish striker, 23, whose United links had seen him booed by the City fans.

But Napoli's lead did not last long thanks to Bouaddi. The elegant Moroccan midfielder had yet to score a goal at senior level in his career but his left-footed effort found its way through Vanja Milinkovic-Savic. Substitute Jeremy Doku provided the spark required.

City were pushing for a winner at that stage, but Lang's exquisite volley on the counter-attack was a reminder that Maresca is having trouble controlling counter-attacks. At least he had kept the mercurial Cherki on the pitch to help avoid a damaging defeat.

But after that seven-game winning run in the Premier League, it is one point from four domestically and now this unconvincing effort in front of their own supporters. City are still a work in progress under Maresca. They will need to improve plenty at Arsenal.

67 - GOAL! Bouaddi's strike levelled it for Man City

76 - GOAL! Lang volleyed in to restore Napoli's lead

86 - GOAL! Cherki's low strike salvaged a point

Man City captain Erling Haaland speaking to TNT Sports:

"We tried to push but we couldn't. It's not good enough. We let them in too easily and were unable to control or attack the game as we want.

"Football can be so difficult and easy. When you win games everything is easy and you know exactly what to do, when you don't win you start to question everything. The perfect thing would be to don't think but it's difficult in these moments.

"We have so much quality. It's about getting that quality out of every single player. We have to regroup to stay positive and bring the energy on the pitch.

"We go to the champions next. The most difficult game of the season. We need a top, top performance."

articles.title: Michigan Drops Plans to Hire New AD Trev Alberts, Decision Might Cost Wolverines Some $21 Million<br
articles.summary: ANN ARBOR, Mich. (AP) — Michigan announced Tuesday that it was dropping plans to hire Trev Alberts of Texas A&M as its next athletic director, a stunning move that sets up a possible legal fight with more than $21 million at stake.
articles.body:
ANN ARBOR, Mich. (AP) — Michigan announced Tuesday that it was dropping plans to hire Trev Alberts of Texas A&M as its next athletic director, a stunning move that sets up a possible legal fight with more than $21 million at stake.

Alberts signed a memorandum of understanding a week ago to take the job at Michigan with a five-year contract with a $3.2 million annual base salary, plus bonuses. But on Tuesday, University of Michigan President Domenico Grasso sent Alberts a letter that he said terminates the agreement.

"As a result of the information gathered as part of the employment process, the university has determined that the background check is not acceptable to the University," Grasso wrote.

The salary and bonuses at stake total about $17.2 million and the memorandum signed Nov. 17 calls for that to be paid out within 75 days. Michigan is also on the hook to pay Texas A&M a $4 million buyout. The Aggies have already named an interim AD since Alberts had been expected to start his job in Ann Arbor on Dec. 1.

"The University of Michigan's search for its next athletic director is ongoing," school spokesman Paul Corliss said. "As we navigate a rapidly changing landscape in intercollegiate athletics, the values that define Michigan will guide our decisions and reinforce our commitment to excellence and integrity, both in the classroom and in competition."

While the school did not explain why it made the move, Alberts is among the defendants in a civil lawsuit where one of his answers in a deposition may have alarmed decision-makers in Ann Arbor. Alberts addressed that in a statement, saying he was "shocked and disheartened" to learn of Michigan's decision.

"The egregious characterization of words taken out of context from a deposition regarding an incident that occurred years ago is wrong and unfair," Alberts said.

A former Nebraska women's basketball player alleges Alberts and coach Amy Williams did not take appropriate action when her sexual relationship with an assistant coach became widely known. Alberts and Williams are accused of not setting rules, training or policies prohibiting staff members from having sexual relationships with athletes.

Alberts was asked on Dec. 4, 2025, if it was true that college coaches should never have sex with the athletes that they are coaching.

"I don't know the answer to that," Alberts said.

"Well, I mean, you know, it just depends," Alberts said.

In Tuesday's statement, Alberts said he was told Michigan's general counsel spoke with attorneys at Texas A&M and Nebraska about the deposition.

"All three of those lawyers told Michigan's GC that I had done nothing wrong or inappropriate and had followed all applicable university policies and procedures," Alberts said. "I am proud of my long track record for standing up for student-athletes and for following the rules and my core values."

Alberts, Williams and the school's regents previously said in their joint response to the civil lawsuit that they didn't have "sufficient information and belief to either admit or deny the allegations" of a sexual relationship.

Michigan was looking for an AD with a strong background in football and seemed to find one in Alberts, who was an All-America linebacker at Nebraska and played in the NFL. Alberts was hired by Texas A&M in 2024 after a three-year run leading the Cornhuskers' athletic department. He went into athletic administration after working as a TV college football analyst. He was athletic director at Nebraska-Omaha from 2009 until Nebraska hired him in 2021.

Michigan's decision to back away from Alberts adds to the turmoil that has shadowed the program for several years.

Athletic director Warde Manuel fired football coach Sherrone Moore nearly a year ago, following a law firm's investigation into a relationship he had with a subordinate. The football program also remains on NCAA probation after football coaches and staff had impermissible contact with recruits and players under then-coach Jim Harbaugh.

Manuel last December hired former Utah coach Kyle Whittingham in a move that excited fans at the time, but he has had an underwhelming debut season. Manuel is also on the way out at the end of the year: He agreed to a buyout of the remaining three years of his contract last July. He has been the Wolverines' AD since 2016, overseeing a department that has won four national championships, including the 2023 title in football.

The next AD will decide whether to give Whittingham a chance to bounce back or find someone else to lead college football's winningest program.

Michigan started the season No. 16 in the AP Top 25 , plummeted out of the poll during the first month of the season and finally became bowl eligible last week with a win against previously unbeaten UCLA . The Wolverines will play archrival Ohio State on the road Saturday.

articles.title: Man Utd transfer spending to be limited by new stadium plans in the short term, says chief executive Omar Berrada
articles.summary: Man Utd potentially find themselves in a relegation battle, but chief executive Omar Berrada admits that transfer funds will be impacted by plans to build a new stadium in the short term, with the club's current long-term debt still in excess of £1.1bn
articles.body:
United are currently second bottom in the Premier League after a damaging start to the season which has seen Michael Carrick sacked as head coach and his replacement Mauricio Pochettino lose his first game in charge 4-0 at arch rivals Liverpool on Sunday.

Sky Sports News understands United plan to back Pochettino in January in a bid to turn the season around amid growing concerns that the club are genuinely in a relegation battle.

But Berrada's comments suggest that some funds will be held back for the stadium plans which have been opposed by match going fans this season.

"If we put all our efforts simply on investing in the squad, yes, we might be able to invest a bit more in the short term, but we have to think about the long term," Berrada told Sky Sports ahead of the Liverpool game.

"We're trying to build a new stadium that will be, in our view, the best football stadium in the world.

"That is going to take us a massive step forward, that's going to deliver a richer experience for our fans and our community, that's going to allow more people to be in the stadium because Old Trafford has a capacity of just under 75,000 and we're aiming to build a stadium that's going to be 100,000."

'We're clear that a new stadium is the better option'

On fan sentiment hardening against the stadium plans, Berrada added: "Of course I see it and I've seen some of the banners and I see just generally the fan sentiment.

"But it's also important to say that we've had lots of dialogue with our fans, we've done I think two surveys, we speak to our fan advisory group, we speak to the fans forum.

"What we hear and what we sense is that the majority of our fans do think that a new stadium is better than redeveloping Old Trafford.

"Redeveloping Old Trafford will come at not just an enormous cost, but also an enormous disruption for our match-going fans for many years and it would come with limitations with the amount of new additional seats that we'd be able to add.

"So we're clear on our idea that a new stadium is the better option and that our aspiration is to build it as soon as possible."

How will Man Utd fund £2bn stadium plans?

Questions remain over how the project, which United estimated would cost £2bn when unveiling plans last March, will be funded. Numerous avenues remain open to the club, including selling off naming rights.

Berrada's comments suggest at least some of the burden will fall on United, who currently owe more than £1.1bn after their long-term debt rose to £557m, according to the club's latest financial results.

The United chief executive insists he is comfortable with United's financial situation and pointed to the fact that total revenue rose by 4.1 per cent compared to the same time last year to £146.1m.

Asked if he understands from a fan perspective that the increasing debt feels like money pouring out of the club that could otherwise be spent on players, Berrada added: "Well, I disagree with that.

"So we're looking at various things and let me just be very clear: our number one ambition and goal is to win and to win titles and to do it as quickly as we can.

"In order to do that, you need to be able to invest in the squad. We want to be in a position where, as a club, we have the ability and the firepower to go to the market, to buy the best players and to invest in our academy to develop the best young players.

"We also have talked very publicly about the aspiration of building a new stadium because I think that's going to be the one thing that will be absolutely transformational for this club, for the wider community, for the city and the wider region.

"And we want to be able to continue investing in that project because we think that's going to give us a massive competitive advantage when we do build it. It's going to give our fans a much better experience in the stadium."

articles.title: Flick: "Debemos mostrar la misma motivación que el Sabah, somos el Barça y esto es la Champions"
articles.standfirst: El preparador valora el estado de su equipo en la previa del cruce en Azerbaiyán
articles.summary: El preparador valora el estado de su equipo en la previa del cruce en Azerbaiyán
articles.body: Hansi Flick expresó esta tarde sus sensaciones de cara al encuentro de mañana miércoles contra el Sabah. El Barça disputa la quinta jornada de la fase de la liguilla de la Champions League en Bakú, y lo hace con una gran baja: la de Lamine Yamal. Sabah "Es un equipo al que le gusta jugar, es valiente. Sale desde atrás. Esto es la Champions y respetamos a todos los rivales. Es un partido muy importante para nosotros". Baja de Lamine "Hemos jugado en el pasado sin él, sabemos qué hacer. Es importante, pero al ver cómo estaba decidimos que se quedara en casa. Le esperamos para el fin de semana". Rotaciones "No he decidido quién jugará por Lamine. Lo veremos mañana. Podría haber rotaciones, son muchos partidos los que debemos disputar en lo que nos resta de año. Hay que ver si otros jugadores distintos tienen minutos". De Jong "Lo que más me gusta de él es que me dice que juega donde yo le necesite. En cualquier posición. Dice que está disponible para cualquier demarcación. Lo da todo por el equipo. Sabemos que es uno de los mejores centrocampistas del mundo. Es centrocampista, le necesitamos en el medio, pero ya veremos mañana... estoy contento por su vuelta y su nivelazo". Cubarsí "Puede jugar mañana, está disponible. Pero Pau no ha estado muy bien en los últimos partidos, no tiene nada preocupante, pero igual necesita algo más de tiempo. Si podemos gestionarlo sin él, lo haremos". Motivación del Sabah "No creo que nosotros nos tengamos que motivar. Somos el Barça. Sabemos que son partidos importantes, son tres puntos. El Sabah juega por primera vez la Champions, les encanta hacerlo y hacerlo contra equipos como el Barça o el United. Están cien por cien motivados. Y nosotros queremos esta misma mentalidad". Banquillo nervioso por Hernández Hernández "Hay muchas emociones en la banquillo y fuera. Se podía ver. Creo que no tenía razón y se lo dijimos al cuarto árbitro. No fue una buena actuación. Si haces bien el trabajo... sé que las cosas se hacen bien, pero hay que comunicarse al mismo nivel, de cara a cara. Tenemos que poder hablar de esto y poder decir que se puede hacer mejor el trabajo. Nosotros también debemos mejorar. Pondremos a Fermín en la segunda fila del banquillo... ". Penaltis "No hemos hablado. Lamine está en Barcelona. Ya lo hablaremos. No es el primer penalti que se falla. Esto es fútbol. Probamos cosas y no funcionamos. Pero estoy contento". Juego "Hemos hablado y el Sabah juega muy bien, podría ser un equipo de LaLiga. Tiene esa filosofía de LaLiga. Sabe jugar a fútbol. Es importante que juguemos con la actitud adecuada".

articles.title: Leny Yoro red card: Ref chief Howard Webb backs process that saw Man Utd defender sent off at Liverpool
articles.summary: Man Utd to contact ProRef and the Premier League over 'totally wrong' interpretation of Leny Yoro's red card; In the latest Match Officials Mic'd Up, ProRef chief refereeing officer Howard Webb analyses decision as audio of how officials handled incident is revealed
articles.body:
Yoro was sent off after eight minutes of Sunday's 4-0 defeat at Anfield and was due to face a one-match ban for denying an obvious goalscoring opportunity when he brought down Alexander Isak outside the box as he was in on goal.

But Man Utd have had the suspension lifted after a successful claim of wrongful dismissal, the FA said on Tuesday. The independent commission will publish the written reasons in "due course".

Referees' chief Howard Webb backed the process of the officials who sent off the Manchester United defender.

However, United boss Mauricio Pochettino questioned why the VAR did not intervene to overturn the on-field decision.

Speaking at a press conference ahead of his team's Champions League match against Sporting in Lisbon on Wednesday, Pochettino said: "Very disappointed because I think this type of thing never can happen.

"My question was always the same - we can accept the referee can make a mistake because of the emotional relationship with the game.

"But if we have VAR, what were they doing? What were they doing? No, because now we are going to repeat the game? We're going to have the possibility to play with the similar tools, 11 against 11?

"The problem is that when we were there, I think they need to take their time to review the situation.

"We have an unbelievable car but we need to be in the level to drive, we need to drive in the best way."

In the latest edition of Match Officials Mic'd Up, Webb, chief refereeing officer at ProRef, described the on-field decision from referee Samuel Barrott as "decisive" and said the point of contention was around whether Isak would beat United goalkeeper Senne Lammens to the ball.

Audio from the officials reveals that the VAR, John Brooks, who backed Barrott's decision, determined Isak was "likely" to get on the end of the ball before Lammens. His assistant VAR, Paul Howard, agreed.

Webb was non-committal in his verdict but backed the process of the officials by saying "most people would see that as a correct decision".

"There's a question mark, I guess, around whether or not he would get onto that ball before Lammens," said Webb. "Now, in the moment, the referee looked at it and felt he would. That was the referee's call made on the field.

"The VAR checks that to see whether that decision made on the field was clearly and obviously incorrect and formed the opinion that it wasn't. If there was any doubt, then it was doubt.

"It wasn't going to be something that was clearly and obviously wrong and therefore allowed that decisive on-field decision to stand. And I think by and large most people would see that as a correct decision with Isak moving quickly on towards that ball.

"The alternative view is that Lammens might get there first, but I think it's a little bit debatable, I guess. Certainly not clearly wrong."

Why Man Utd are contacting ProRef and Premier League

Manchester United strongly believe the incident was a result of a process error and a failure to interpret the rules correctly.

Club sources believe on the VAR audio there is a quick look and consensus to support the referee with no meaningful challenge or consideration there was an error.

United are also understood to be unhappy there has been no recognition from ProRef that the red card was incorrect after the disciplinary panel overturned the decision.

United believe it is not a subjective decision. If Isak had maintained his top-recorded speed, he still could not have reached the ball before Senne Lammens and the club believe it is objectively provable and they could have shown this on the data within minutes.

ProRef did not want to comment further when contacted by Sky Sports News .

Earlier this season, Pro Ref admitted an error in awarding Manchester City's winner at Manchester United in their 1-0 victory at Old Trafford and contacted the club to explain how the VAR "should have recommended an on-field review" for Erling Haaland's winner.

Sky Sports News understands United received an apology over the incorrect VAR decision.

REF - Sam Barrott: DOGSO (Denying an obvious goalscoring opportunity), DOGSO.

REF: Outside and it's a red card for DOGSO. On-field decision is outside, red card for DOGSO.

VAR - John Brooks: Checking the on-field decision of DOGSO. Longer loop, please.

Replay Operator: Happy with this as the point of contact?

VAR: Yeah, point of contact. Go 18 [yard] now, go 18. Clearly outside. First contact, clearly outside.

VAR: So, Isak is the right side, defender is the wrong side. Defender bundles into him, into the back. Gets too tight. I think it's a foul. Go back to 18-yard. Let's roll it through, firstly to see whether the attacker is going to get on the end of the ball. Just roll it through, real speed.

VAR: So, at full speed, Isak maintains his momentum and likely gets on the end of it. Certainly not clearly wrong that he doesn't. So I think the DOGSO is confirmed. We'll just check APP (Attacking Possession Phase).

VAR: Sam [referee], the DOGSO location and sanction is confirmed. Just checking the rest of the APP.

VAR: Yeah: Frame two, clearly onside. We've seen it all. Doesn't control the ball with the arm or anything, yes. Sam, confirming the on-field decision of a free-kick to Liverpool just outside the box and a denial of a goalscoring opportunity.

Head of Pro Ref Howard Webb on Mic'D Up:

"Firstly, I think this was a really decisive decision by the referee Sam Barrott. We know it is clearly a foul and we also know it is outside the penalty area.

"We're thinking about the sanction. Is it a denial of an obvious goal scoring opportunity? There's actually four considerations officials have to think about.

"Direction of play: he is definitely going towards the goal. It's not going out wide. Proximity from goal: it's just outside the penalty area.

"The location of other defenders: there's only Yoro there. The keeper is moving back towards his own goal. He has to put the brakes on and possibly come back out.

"The reason we're talking about it is the fourth consideration. That's control or likelihood of keeping on or gaining control of the ball. Isak's got control of the ball. He's got possession. He's got the touch. He knocks it past Yoro. He's moving at pace at that moment. And a foul comes in and knocks him down.

"And there's a question mark, I guess, around whether or not he would get onto that ball before Lammens. Now, in the moment, the referee looked at it and felt he would. That was the referee's call made on the field.

articles.title: Leny Yoro's red card for Manchester United against Liverpool overturned following successful appeal
articles.summary: Man Utd defender Leny Yoro's red at Liverpool has been overturned after a successful appeal; Yoro was sent off inside the first eight minutes for denying a clear goalscoring opportunity; United informed The FA of their plans to appeal decision on Monday; Yoro available to face Brentford
articles.body:
Mauricio Pochettino's side lost 4-0 at Anfield in the Argentine's first game in charge, and his plans went up in smoke when Yoro was dismissed after eight minutes for bundling over Alexander Isak as the striker ran through on goal.

Yoro was set to serve a one-match suspension but it has now been removed after United successfully lodged an appeal for wrongful dismissal.

The 21-year-old will now be available to face Brentford on Saturday at Old Trafford.

Debate on whether the foul was a clear denial of a goalscoring opportunity centred on whether Isak would have kept possession of ball as he approached the penalty area.

Under the laws of the game, one of the considerations regarding a red card for denying an obvious goalscoring opportunity (DOGSO) is the likelihood of the attacking player "keeping or gaining control of the ball".

In the latest edition of Match Officials Mic'D Up , Pro Ref chief refereeing officer Howard Webb backed the process of his officials although was non-committal when sharing his own verdict on the incident.

"I think by and large most people would see that as a correct decision with Isak moving quickly on towards that ball," said Webb.

"The alternative view is that Lammens might get there first, but I think it's a little bit debatable, I guess. Certainly not clearly wrong."

Audio from the officials reveals that the VAR, John Brooks , who backed referee Samuel Barrott's decision, determined Isak was "likely" to get on the end of the ball before Lammens. His assistant VAR, Paul Howard, agreed.

United boss Pochettino felt that not only did Isak lose control of the ball with a heavy touch, but that United should have been given a penalty for Jeremy Jacquet's challenge on Bryan Mbeumo at the opposite end just moments before.

However, former Premier League referee Dermot Gallagher backed the on-field decision in both instances.

"If you look at it from the referee's angle, is it a foul? That's the first step. Yes. Is he in possession of the ball? From that angle, yes," Gallagher said on Sky Sports News .

"I think most people would have expected a red card. It would have been a surprise during the game if a red card hadn't been given.

"I don't know if he would have got to the ball before Lammens."

'A subjective decision where different people have different opinions'

Analysis from Sky Sports News' Kaveh Solhekol:

"Manchester United felt strongly that this was a case of wrongful dismissal. They had until 1pm to contact the FA on Monday and tell them they intended to submit a claim of wrongful dismissal, which is what they did.

"Then they had until 1pm on Tuesday to submit any evidence they had to support their claim. The commission then met to hear the case and at that hearing, the onus was on Man Utd to demonstrate using video or written evidence that the officials had made a clear and obvious error. We haven't seen the written reasons yet, although we should get them maybe next week or the week after.

"The key factor in this is one of the four factors that the officials had to decide on is whether this was an obvious goal-scoring opportunity. In this case, it was whether the attacker Isak had or could gain control of the ball.

"This commission have decided that he didn't have control of the ball and he couldn't gain control of the ball and that is why they have decided that this is a case of wrongful dismissal.

"Now we've got a situation where Webb has said the referee made an instant decision that was not a wrong decision. He was decisive, he made the call, he sent the player off and he also feels the VAR team made the right decision as well by not getting involved because in his opinion, the official Sam Barrott didn't make a clear and obvious error. That is why Webb is saying he's happy with what he saw.

"The FA independent commission appears to have come to a different opinion about whether Isak had control or could gain control of the ball. What's interesting is we don't yet know who was on this commission, but we'll find out when the written reasons are released.

"I think it's one of those subjective decisions where different people have different opinions, but most people, when they saw it first time round at normal speed, would have thought that is a red card."

Pochettino: 'The ball was for the goalkeeper'

United boss Pochettino said it was not a denial of a goalscoring opportunity as goalkeeper Senne Lammens was the favourite to claim it and Yoro did not intentionally make contact with Isak.

"The ball was for the goalkeeper. In that situation, if you review the VAR you can see for sure, [Yoro] never had the intention to connect with Isak," Pochettino said after the game.

"When the control was long with the striker, the ball was going to the goalkeeper."

United midfielder Kobbie Mainoo also disagreed with the on-field decision.

"The game's been taken out of our hands by a red card that I don't think can be a red card," he said.

"No chance. The ball's already with the goalkeeper."

This is not the first time this season that a DOGSO red card has created division within the football authorities.

In October, two independent panels disagreed over whether Brighton's Pascal Struijk deserved to be sent off at Sunderland, adding to the confusion of former Premier League referees and Sky Sports pundits.

Struijk was dismissed for denying an obvious goal-scoring opportunity in the second half when he was adjudged to have fouled Sunderland striker Wilson Isidor as he tried to latch on to a pass that ran through to goalkeeper Bart Verbruggen.

Neither referee Thomas Bramall nor his assistant gave a foul, but VAR Neil Davies intervened and recommended an on-field review. Bramall watched several replays before changing his decision and dismissing Struijk.

However, Brighton appealed and an independent regulatory commission, which is convened through the FA to consider disciplinary matters, overturned the red card and subsequent one-match ban.

But disagreements over the decision continued after the Key Match Incidents (KMI) panel voted 3-2 that the VAR intervention was correct.

The KMI panel ruled that Struijk committed a "cynical foul clearly impacting the attacker's ability to gain possession of the ball which should have been penalised by the referee".

So as we have seen once again in Yoro's overturned red card, two out of the three panels - Pro Ref and the Football Association - have disagreed with each other.

We wait with bated breath to see what the KMI does when its findings are revealed in the coming weeks. Which side will it pick? And will it add to the confusion once again?

articles.title: Jurrien Timber's shirt-pull on Alexander Isak: Ref chief Howard Webb admits 'quick check' in Arsenal's win at Liverpool
articles.summary: Alexander Isak was not awarded a penalty during Arsenal's win at Liverpool in November despite Jurrien Timber pulling his shirt; referee Andy Madley gave nothing on-field and VAR Stuart Attwell did not intervene; independent Key Match Incidents (KMI) panel gives verdict
articles.body:
Webb also said Isak's lack of a "natural reaction" to Timber's shirt pull on him was a factor in the decision not to award a penalty after the striker did not go down or protest the decision.

Earlier this month, the Premier League's Key Match Incidents Panel ruled Liverpool should have been awarded a penalty for Timber's shirt tug on Isak inside the box at a cross.

Upon a review of the incident on Match Officials Mic'd Up , it was revealed that VAR Stuart Attwell spotted the shirt-pull offence but decided it was "all fine" 11 seconds later.

After declaring it was "all fine", referee Andy Madley and the assistant referee asked for clarification, which Attwell immediately responded to with "all fine", meaning the total check took only 18 seconds.

It was also revealed that VAR did not look at the reverse angle, which gave a clearer view of Timber's shirt pull.

Questioned on the speed of the call, Webb replied: "It was a quick check. You heard what the referee said on the field, and he thought at full speed, 'That's what I'm seeing as well'.

"This slow-motion freeze frame is distorting reality, and therefore we always have to view these things in reality and primarily at full speed, with some slow-motion for some of the detail.

"But in this situation, to get this sort of impact you're getting here, you're freeze-framing it, and that's what we're trying not to do because it's distorting reality."

Isak stayed on his feet during the incident, and Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola said afterwards he would tell the striker to go down next time as the Reds were beaten 1-0 by Mikel Arteta's side.

The KMI panel voted 4:1 that referee Madley should have awarded Liverpool a spot-kick, while the panel also voted 3:2 that Attwell should have intervened and sent Madley to the pitchside monitor on the basis that it was a clear and obvious error.

One KMI panellist believed "the short-lived holding to lack clear impact on the ability of Isak to progress", while two panellists argued, "the subjectivity in assessing impact meant this did not meet the high threshold for VAR intervention".

Webb said: "Certainly most of the feedback we've had is that a penalty should've been given.

"But I want to talk about why that didn't happen and why in the stadium the officials took the decision.

"Simply shirt-pulling or holding somebody on a football field isn't in itself always punishable. We see a lot of grappling and holding, and we don't see that being penalised.

"It's all about the impact you have on the opponent you hold. In this situation, the referee sees what he describes as a 'small hold that doesn't have an impact'. He does reference the fact that Isak doesn't ask him a question.

"I think it's reasonable if a player is held and is impacted for there to be some form of natural reaction from being impacted in that sort of way, and we certainly don't see that here.

"We never wanted to encourage players to dive or to throw themselves down, so you're not going to get the decision you want just by throwing yourself to the floor.

"When you look at this brief hold at full speed, it looks a lot worse when it's played out in slow motion. It lasts four times as long and therefore looks much more impactful.

"Most people think that this sort of reach out on a player in front of goal should be penalised, but I absolutely understand why when looking at impact from a brief hold to no natural reaction that only becomes clear in slow-motion is not penalised on-field, and the VAR understandably check completed the referee's call which was brief hold, no impact."

Jamie Carragher: "One of the best goalscorers in the league is pulled back seven yards out and it stops him heading the ball - why does he need to make a meal of it? VAR, do your job."

Ian Wright: "He shouldn't have to make more of it. We can see it... Unless I'm pulled back, I'm going to head it as much as I can. When he pulled him, it was just about enough as he would need to go down.

"VAR is wrong in this instance. If they gave that penalty, I wouldn't sit here and say 'I can't believe they gave that'."

Gary Neville: "It's actually unnatural not to make more of it. When you get pulled and you're just about to score, you ordinarily complain like crazy. It's a very odd reaction from Isak."

Daniel Sturridge: "Unfortunately, he (Isak) has not fallen over. You're supposed to fall over, put your arms in the air and show the referee you're mad about it... to me, his reaction is almost like 'VAR, do your job'.

"But they've not done their job. He shouldn't have to make more of it - clearly, he shouldn't. Everyone can see that his arm is stretched; he [Timber] is holding him with a stretched-out arm."

Former Premier League referee Dermot Gallagher: "It depends which angle you watch it from. The first angle, you see nothing. That is the referee's angle.

"The second angle, which is what VAR looks at, and it is a lot more damning.

"VAR looks at it in slow motion, which is another thing against him. In normal speed, he grabs and grabs him quickly but let's go. Does he do enough [for a penalty]?

"What is Timber's intention? He is on the wrong side of him. Does he do enough to stop him? He [Isak] will say yes, as he is close to the ball.

"VAR would be accused of re-refereeing if it is a penalty. It is a case of damned if they do and damned if they don't.

"It has to be the case of on-field. The more I watch it, the more I think he [Timber] has taken a big chance and has got lucky."

What happens if Isak goes down? "Once a player hits the ground, there are more questions to ask.

"There is asking what has knocked him down. Has he gone down by his own momentum, has he slipped or has he been pulled or pushed?

"Once you factor that in, obviously you have a different decision. He [referee] has to deal with the situation he has seen. He has seen a little pull of the jersey and thought no penalty."

Jay Bothroyd: "Where was the referee? Every angle, I can see it is a penalty.

"He has pulled his shirt. How can none of them [referee and VAR] see that and say it is a penalty? I can't comprehend that. I don't get it.

"That is one of the most obvious penalties [I have seen]. He is running forward! He has stifled his momentum going forward, to stop him heading the ball.

"Every angle I look at, even normal time, I said it could be a penalty. I look at it now, the more I see it, the more I ask myself how they have missed it! How do they lose focus and not get that."

articles.title: Deion Sanders Addresses Hot Seat Speculation on Video Amid Colorado's Losing Season
articles.summary: Colorado football head coach Deion Sanders isn't concerned about any speculation regarding his future with the program amid some speculation that he may be on the hot seat amid his third losing season in four years with the Buffaloes.
articles.body:
Colorado football head coach Deion Sanders isn't concerned about any speculation regarding his future with the program amid some speculation that he may be on the hot seat amid his third losing season in four years with the Buffaloes.

"Do you think that bothers me? Do you think that causes me to lose sleep or rest? Do you think that affects or infects my life?" Sanders began.

"I'm here on assignment for these kids and if i'm not here any longer i'll move on to God's next assignment, so that don't affect me like it may affect you or may affect some others.

"I'm in the third quarter of life. I may be losing games, but I'm winning life."

In 2023, Sanders took over a program that had gone 4-23 over its previous two seasons. Colorado started 3-0 in 2023 and was ranked as high as No. 18 but lost eight of its nine Big 12 games to finish 4-8.

However, the Buffaloes drastically improved in 2024, going 9-4 (7-2 in the Big 12) and finishing 25th in the final Associated Press poll. Two-way star Travis Hunter won the Heisman Trophy, and Sanders' son, Shedeur Sanders, threw for 4,134 yards and 37 touchdowns. Both went onto the NFL after the season. Sanders signed a five-year, $54 million contract extension through 2029 in March 2025, per ESPN's Heather Dinich .

Colorado has fallen on hard times ever since. The Buffaloes went 1-8 in the Big 12 again in 2025 en route to a 3-9 record. This year's team is 4-7 overall (2-6 Big 12) with a home game against UCF remaining to close out the season.

Sanders did a great job turning the program around in 2024 and igniting interest and passion into the Buffaloes after they endured hard times. However, Colorado has simply gone in the wrong direction in the past two seasons, and its Big 12 struggles continue.

Per Pete Nakos of On3, Sanders' buyout is $25 million.

"Colorado and Deion Sanders are 1-10 on the road the last two years," Nakos said. "With a buyout of approximately $25 million, it remains to be seen if the Buffaloes have the money to move on from Sanders. Sources do not expect any final decision on Sanders' future until the regular season concludes next week against UCF."

Sanders' future in Boulder is unclear at this point, but it's clear he's at peace with whatever happens. Ultimately, Colorado does have one 2026 game left, and it'll be in Boulder on Saturday at 2 p.m. ET.

articles.title: Yahoo Sports Network to stream 25 live Major Arena Soccer League matches this season
articles.summary: Yahoo Sports Network, the free streaming channel operated by C15 Studio, will be the exclusive home for 25 Major Arena Soccer League regular-season matches.
articles.body:
Fans in the U.S. have a new way to experience the speed, skill, and excitement of professional indoor soccer. Beginning this season, Yahoo Sports Network , the free streaming channel operated by C15 Studio, will be the exclusive home for 25 Major Arena Soccer League (MASL) regular-season matches.

articles.title: El monumental cabreo de Bellingham con el cuarto árbitro
articles.standfirst: El centrocampista inglés, acompañado por Huijsen, trató de explicar la acción del penalti mientras se revisaba en el VAR... y acabó marchándose al banquillo
articles.summary: El centrocampista inglés, acompañado por Huijsen, trató de explicar la acción del penalti mientras se revisaba en el VAR... y acabó marchándose al banquillo
articles.body: A Jude Bellingham le hervía la sangre en la banda. Cuando el árbitro principal, Espen Eskas, fue llamado por el VAR para revisar el posible penalti de Tchouaméni sobre Mijnans, el centrocampista inglés no pudo quedarse al margen. Acompañado por Huijsen, se acercó al cuarto árbitro mientras el colegiado revisaba la acción en el monitor. Bellingham trató primero de explicarle lo sucedido, intentando hacerle llegar su interpretación de la jugada. Sin embargo, a medida que avanzaba la revisión, su gesticulación fue aumentando y su enfado se hizo cada vez más evidente. El inglés seguía muy pendiente de lo que sucedía en el monitor y no ocultaba su disconformidad con la posibilidad de que se señalara la pena máxima. La monumental pitada del Bernabéu terminó por confirmar el desenlace. Penalti. Bellingham se dio la vuelta negando con la cabeza, visiblemente contrariado, y soltó un último aspaviento antes de poner rumbo al banquillo. Su reacción dejó una de las imágenes de la revisión, con el inglés incapaz de disimular su enfado. El lanzamiento desde los once metros, ejecutado por Perisic, fue impecable para adelantar al PSV en el Bernabéu.

articles.title: Leny Yoro red card: Mauricio Pochettino leads Manchester United fury at VAR ruling
articles.summary: Manchester United and Mauricio Pochettino are furious at how Leny Yoro's red card has been handled by VAR John Brooks and referees' chief Howard Webb
articles.body:
Manchester United head coach Mauricio Pochettino has questioned the competence of video assistant referee officials after defender Leny Yoro had his red card overturned by the Football Association.

Yoro was sent off eight minutes into United's 4-0 defeat at Liverpool on Sunday after bringing down Aleksander Isak just outside the United penalty area.

United sources say they have conclusive proof it was impossible for Isak to reach the ball after he took a heavy touch, that it would have run on to goalkeeper Senne Lammens and Yoro should not have been punished for denying a goalscoring opportunity.

Pochettino said he had some sympathy with referee Sam Barrott but he is livid at how the situation played out.

"I am very disappointed," the Argentine said. "This type of thing can never happen.

"We can accept the referee can make a mistake. But if we have VAR, what were they doing? What were they doing? Are we going to repeat the game? Are we going to have the possibility to play 11 by 11? No.

"We have an unbelievable car, but we need to be at the level to drive [it]. We accept that the technology is there but what are they doing?"

United are furious at both the nature of the audio of the incident, and referees' chief Howard Webb defending referee Barrott's decision and the VAR John Brooks' reinforcing it on the Mic'd Up programme, which was shown on Sky Sports.

They intend to take the matter up with both the Premier League and ProRef.

It is the second time this season United been on the wrong end of a major VAR error.

Webb apologised to United after Erling Haaland's winner in the Manchester derby at Old Trafford on 13 September was allowed to stand even though a clearly offside Enzo Fernandez was interfering with play.

There has been no apology from Webb on this occasion.

Instead, he has doubled down on the call, saying: "I think, by and large, most people would see that as a correct decision, with Isak moving quickly on towards that ball."

United sources claim this interpretation is wrong.

The club are unhappy at the speed the on-field decision was confirmed. It is thought United used data around Isak's top speed and his chances of reaching the ball in their defence of Yoro to the FA. They claim this could have been done "within minutes" of the incident occurring.

This is not the only bone of contention at Old Trafford around the incident.

Pochettino also pointed out Liverpool forward Bradley Barcola was too close to the United wall from the resulting free-kick and Dominik Szoboszlai's opening goal should have been disallowed.

"No-one talked about [the fact] that the goal wasn't legal," said Pochettino. "Barcola was touching our wall. It must be disallowed.

"We need to defend my players and my club, and that is to denounce it and to say, the decision wasn't good. And now, the three points, where are the three points?"

What referee's chief Webb said about the incident on the Mic'd Up programme.

"There's a question mark, I guess, around whether or not he would get onto that ball before Lammens. Now, in the moment, the referee looked at it and felt he would.

"That was the referee's call made on the field, and then the VAR checks that to see whether that decision made on the field was clearly and obviously incorrect, and formed the opinion that it wasn't.

"That if there was any doubt, then it was doubt.

"It wasn't going to be something that was clearly and obviously wrong and therefore allowed that decisive on-field decision to stand. and

"I think, by and large, most people would see that as a correct decision, with Isak moving quickly on towards that ball.

"The alternative view is that Lammens might get there first, but I think it's a little bit debatable. Certainly not clearly wrong."

We're not fragile, we are strong - Pochettino

United's fury over Yoro and the way the situation has been handled cannot completely obscure the fact they lost 4-0 in Pochettino's first game in charge.

It extended a terrible start to the season that has seen the Red Devils win on just three occasions - and only once in the Premier League, against newly-promoted Ipswich in August.

The club are 19th in the Premier League and facing up to the possibility of being relegated for the first time since 1973-74.

Yet Pochettino is adamant there is no fragility about his new squad.

"The situation is fragile in [terms of] the environment, or the people want it to look like we're fragile. But I don't say that we are fragile. I think we are strong.

"We have great mentality and a great mindset.

"There are many things we need to improve. It's normal to be in a different position, and everyone can use different words to describe the situation.

"But we are a strong team. They showed that last season, capable of finishing third. I think we are going to turn around the situation and start to perform in the level like before Bruno [Fernandes] said, deserve to be at this club."

Skipper Bruno Fernandes revealed at the weekend talks over a new United contract were on hold.

The 32-year-old's present deal expires in the summer, although the club have an option to extend it by 12 months.

Speaking alongside Pochettino at a media conference before his first meeting with Sporting since he left to join United in a £47m deal in January 2020, Fernandes said his sole focus at present is to drag United out of the mire.

"For us to start winning games, then we can start speaking about contract," he said.

"It's not important now. It's irrelevant. Obviously, I know it's my future and I probably shouldn't look into that way because I haven't got much left in my contract, but I'm not really worried about that.

"I'm more worried about getting results, trying to bring the club back in a position that we can be proud of, and we're not there at the moment."
